title: Исход 27 — Exodus 27
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Сделай из ___ жертвенник высотой в три локтя.
cases.translation: Make the altar of acacia wood, three cubits high.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of / made from) takes the genitive → акации.
Жертвенник is the direct object of покрой (overlay); for an inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative → жертвенник.

cases.sentence: Сделай из акации шесты для жертвенника и покрой их ___.
cases.translation: Make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
cases.explain: The verb покрыть (to cover/overlay) takes the instrumental for the material used → бронзой.

cases.sentence: …на каждом из четырёх углов ___ сделай по бронзовому кольцу.
cases.translation: …on each of the four corners of the net make a bronze ring.
cases.explain: Possession ("the corners of the net") is expressed by the genitive → сетки.

cases.translation: Make a courtyard for the tabernacle.
cases.explain: Двор is the direct object of сделай; for an inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative → двор.

cases.sentence: Южная сторона будет сто локтей в длину, отгороженная ___ крученого льна.
cases.translation: The south side shall be a hundred cubits long, screened off with hangings of twined linen.
cases.explain: The instrumental names the means by which the side is fenced off (screened with curtains) → завесами (instrumental plural).

cases.sentence: …чтобы в ___ можно было постоянно поддерживать огонь.
cases.translation: …so that a fire could be kept burning continually in the lamps.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a location takes the prepositional → светильниках (prepositional plural).

cases.sentence: Его нужно сделать точно по ___, данному тебе на горе.
cases.translation: It must be made exactly according to the pattern given to you on the mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition по meaning "according to" takes the dative → образцу.

reading.ru: Сделай из акации жертвенник высотой в три локтя, пусть он будет квадратным, пять локтей в длину и пять в ширину.
reading.question: What shape and size was the altar to be?
options: Square, five cubits by five, and three cubits high
Triangular, four cubits on a side
reading.correct: Square, five cubits by five, and three cubits high
reading.explain: The altar was to be square, five cubits long and five wide, and three cubits high.

reading.ru: Сделай на каждом из его углов рог, так чтобы рога и жертвенник были одним целым.
reading.question: What was to be made on each corner of the altar?
reading.explain: A horn was to be made on each of the altar's corners, of one piece with it.

reading.ru: Западная сторона была 50 локтей в ширину, отгороженная завесами, с 10 столбами на основаниях.
reading.question: How wide was the west side of the courtyard?
reading.explain: The west side of the court was fifty cubits wide, with ten pillars on their bases.

reading.ru: Все столбы вокруг двора должны быть серебряными, с связями и крюками на основаниях из бронзы.
reading.question: What were the pillars around the courtyard to be like?
reading.explain: All the pillars around the court were to be silver, with their bases made of bronze.

reading.ru: Вели израилетянам принести тебе чистое оливковое масло для освещения, чтобы в светильниках можно было постоянно поддерживать огонь.
reading.question: What were the Israelites to bring, and for what purpose?
options: Pure olive oil, to keep the lamps burning continually
reading.correct: Pure olive oil, to keep the lamps burning continually
reading.explain: They were to bring pure olive oil so a fire could burn continually in the lamps.

reading.ru: Израилетяне и их потомки должны соблюдать это установление навеки.
reading.question: How long were the Israelites to keep this statute?
reading.explain: The Israelites and their descendants were to observe this statute forever.
